input.objective: Launch PLEA test run 7 on Sepolia from this Foundry repository exactly as launch.json lists it: five contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, PleaLaunch), deployed in order in one transaction with the constructor arguments in launch.json. This is the final code rehearsed once on Sepolia: run 6's code (branch testnet6 @ 6ef22d1: your run-5 delivery 0f7b870c plus the agreed-clock check moved from CabalGate's constructor to PleaLaunch.seed, the gate scoring an appeal's share band on the lesser of its own share and the original's, and the Tribunal never holding an excluded seller's plea) plus the run-7 batch and the fixes from your audit template's rounds 1 and 2 (audit/FINDINGS.md R1-* and R2-*, audit/rounds/, tests in test/AuditRound1.t.sol): (1) letters pay no 0.35 IMD auto-sell fee (Letterbox._deliver takes it only from the site's auto-sell box, a plea without the BY_LETTER flag; the 0.70 IMD floor stays for both; new Letterbox hash); (2) an over-long letter is refused with LetterTooLong(bytes, 280); (3) season points are the score times 1.2, rounded down, when the seller holds at least one IMD seat NFT at record time (Seasons' fourth constructor argument = the IMD NFT (test) 0xa0443799c320e16c80801c9c1911f3571260287f on Sepolia; binary, points only, the 60-point bar and the Tribunal's score/need comparison untouched; read with a gas-capped staticcall that never blocks a record); (4) the owner's fee is 0.75% (PleaHook.OWNER_BPS 75; 2.0% in all: 0.5% cashback, 0.75% owner, 0.25% prize pot, 0.25% wall, 0.25% of the PLEA burned); (5) the cap ratchet reaches its 900,000 PLEA floor in 15 days (CAP_DECAY_DAYS 15); (6) PleaDistributor is Ownable2Step and cannot be renounced before its root is set; (7) the need is recalibrated: the fact score is 0-45 (share of the balance sold at most 15%: 16, at most 30%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 8, at most 200%: 3; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0), need = 71 - fact (PASS_MARK 71; CannotPass above 45), the judges' scale and DEFINITIONS unchanged; letters plead 15% (LETTER_SHARE_BPS 1500); (8) the audit rounds' fixes (FINDINGS.md R1-*, R2-*). Objection! (src/Tribunal.sol, spec OBJECTIONS.md; ownerless; deployed after the launch through PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) against the keccak256 committed as PleaLaunch's 13th argument): for 20 minutes after an approval anyone except the seller and the wallets Seasons excludes may object (0.5 IMD oracle fee minted on Sepolia like the Letterbox's, a 0.35 IMD stake in pool IMD); a fresh panel re-scores the plea; sustained when newScore + 2 < need (no points, stake back), otherwise overruled (stake to the plea's season pot through settle and Seasons.checkpointObjection); a refused or split panel or 20 minutes without a ruling voids it (stake back); the recorded score is the lowest any panel gave; at most two rulings per plea from different wallets; the sale is never touched and rulings never reset the dead-man. Numbers: PLEA.init mints 82% to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor (one Merkle root for the swarm's 10% and a 2% airdrop); the PLEA bonus is 10,000,000 PLEA for each of the first six seasons; Seasons pays the top 25 wallets with 60 or more points shares from 450 down to 350 basis points in a straight line (Seasons.shareBps). Everything else is run 6's. Build: the whole tree compiles under via_ir as one slow solc job (two contracts sit near the size limit): run forge build --skip test --skip script first (under a minute), then the tests in groups with forge test --match-path 'test/{A,B}.t.sol' (each group compiles only its own files); the default Foundry profile skips the fork, invariant and adversarial suites, which run under FOUNDRY_PROFILE=full one file at a time (the forks skip without their RPC URL variables); never a single forge build of the whole tree, it exceeds a 10-minute command limit. The suite is 627 tests in 78 suites; test/LaunchManifest.t.sol ties launch.json to both committed code hashes, keeps its notes under the manifest's 4,000-character cap and asserts the launch fits the 16,777,216-gas cap with your factory's 22% headroom (13,525,907 as charged, 16,501,606 with headroom, 275,610 under). Audit the imported code and deploy it unchanged; fix only what the audit proves is a real bug, and keep every number as it is (fees 2.0% with owner 0.75, timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 5-hour seasons, 33-hour dead-man, START 1792162800, credit gas 1300000, letters 15%, need 71 minus the fact score with the fact table above, plea 1% to 50% or 2.5M, 0.70 IMD minimum plea value, 95% sale minimum, fee cap +10%, six bonus seasons of 10,000,000 PLEA, the 82/6/12 split, top 25 from 450 to 350 bps, the 1.2 seat multiplier, cap decay 15 days, objection window 20 minutes, stake 0.35 IMD, margin 2, two rulings per plea). If you change the Letterbox or the Tribunal, update its code hash in launch.json. Runtime sizes: CabalGate 24,493 bytes (83 under the EIP-170 limit: do not add code to it), PleaHook 24,137, Letterbox 22,964, Tribunal 20,116, Seasons 12,473: keep any fix within them. Keep PLEA.setLauncher accepting either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, and keep foundry.toml as it is, including the default profile's skip list, [lint] lint_on_build = false and the read-only fs_permissions for ./out and ./launch.json.
